issues.body: `_supersede_fallback_alert` calls `_gh(["issue", "comment", ...])` without checking `returncode`, then unconditionally prints success and returns `True`. If the close succeeds but the comment fails, `decide` exits green even though the promised still-firing supersede explanation was never delivered. The next tick cannot repair this partial transition because `_find_marker_issue(..., "open")` no longer sees the closed issue and returns the already-reconciled success path. The new assertions inspect only comments that the fake successfully appends; the fake has no non-crashing comment-failure mode, so this failure remains untested.
issues.fix_hint: Make close-plus-explanation a confirmed, retryable transition whose incomplete state remains discoverable after close success and comment failure. Add a fake comment failure that returns nonzero without crashing, assert the run does not certify success, then prove a later tick completes the missing explanation without false recovery wording or a second alert.
issues.title: Supersede still succeeds when its required explanation is not delivered

verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-4 major remains unchanged. `_supersede_fallback_alert` still ignores the return code from `gh issue comment`, prints success, and returns `True` after only the close is confirmed. A non-crashing comment failure therefore certifies an incomplete close-plus-explanation transition, and later ticks cannot repair it because the helper searches only open issues. The expanded tests record successful comments but the fake still cannot fail a comment, so they do not exercise the prior finding. Progress is stagnant.
